gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (pp5-6) prints transfers only as one row per fund; Total Governmental Funds column (89,510) out (p6), which is the net figure the statement JSON uses. detail[] records them gross per fund: General Fund General department (109,639) (p17) and Community Redevelopment Authority Fund (1,934) (p16) = 111,573 out; ins General Fund Fire 5,000 (p17) + Ambulance 5,000 (p18) + Sales Tax Fund 11,063 (p13) + Escher Fund 1,000 (p14) = 22,063. 111,573 - 22,063 = 89,510 = printed net (the other side is the Water Fund 'Transfers from other funds' 89,510, p8). The 22,063 gap is the intra-governmental transfers recorded gross; no fix.

Proprietary funds statement of revenues, expenses and changes in net position (p8) prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Sales + Other revenue + Gain (loss) on investments + Grant income. Electric: 817,281 + 1,989 + 12,861 + 37,600 = 869,731; Water: 157,497 - 3,961 - 129 + 285,456 = 438,863; Sewer: 46,944; Trash: 78,448 + 60 = 78,508. Sum 1,434,046 = statement total.
